body:
Reboot recovery (Phase 1). serve.py (:8088, checkpoint-emily-ft) and cmd/broker (:8679) had no
systemd unit and were down after the box upgrade — both restarted manually per
EMILY/docs/REBOOT_RUNBOOK.md, with one doc correction: the runbook's cd/path for cmd/broker
(gpt2-alpine-c) was wrong — the actual source lives in PRRJECT_FATBABY/cmd/broker, with
gpt2-alpine-c/config/broker-routes.json as the routing config for the emily-prime tenant.

Direct smoke test against serve.py /generate (prompt="test", max_tokens=5):
  {"text": "\n\nIf you are", "prompt": "test", "tokens": 5, "model": "emily-ft (checkpoint-emily-ft)"}
Took ~8 minutes wall time (single-threaded CPU inference, cold start) — HTTP 200.

Broker path (localhost:8679/generate) failed with 502 "upstream unavailable" on the same request,
three times. Root cause: cmd/broker/main.go hardcodes a 30s ResponseHeaderTimeout / context
timeout on the upstream call, well under serve.py's real inference latency. This predates the
reboot (not something the reboot broke) but effectively means the broker path is non-functional
for any real generation request today. Flagging for backlog scoping rather than patching
unilaterally during reboot recovery.
title: Post-reboot gpt2 smoke test: serve.py + broker manually restarted
